statement.p: Suppose that f(x) is a function with f(105) = 25 and f'(105) = 1. Estimate f(104).

static.solution: f(105) = 25 and f'(105) = 1 tell us that at x = 105, the value of the function is 25 and the function is increasing at a rate of 1 units for a unit increase in x. Since we increase x by -1 units in going from 105 to 104, the value of the function goes up by approximately -1 \cdot 1 = -1 units, so f(104) \approx 25 - 1 \cdot 1 = 25 - 1 = 24.
